blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Filipino pole vault star EJ Obiena came to the defense of Alex Eala, who’s been facing criticism over her recent string of early exits. In a lengthy post on social media, Obiena spoke broadly about the nature of competing in professional sports and how “failure is not synonymous with losing.” “So asking if Alex’s string of losses suggests she has failed is the wrong question (or for any national athlete for that matter, yours truly included),” the two-time Olympian wrote on Monday.
